result.topic_en: Product formulas for Gauss's two-argument theta-type products (x, α), and their use to express the quotients (1+2x+2x^4+…)/(1+2x^5+2x^20+…) and (1+2x+2x^4+…)/(1+2x^25+2x^100+…) in terms of such products, from which two theorems to be proved are said to follow.
result.transcription:
Hieraus ferner
[73] $(x,\alpha).(x,\beta) + (x,\frac{x}{\alpha})(x,\frac{x}{\beta})\sqrt{\frac{x}{\alpha\beta}} = \frac{[-[x]-][x^4]^2}{[xx]^2}\{x^{\frac12},\sqrt{\alpha\beta}\}.\{x^{\frac12},\sqrt{\frac{\beta}{\alpha}}\}$
oder
[74] $(x,\alpha)(x,\beta) = \frac{[x^4]^2}{[x^2]^2}\{(xx,\alpha\beta).(xx,\frac{\alpha}{\beta}) + \quad xx$
wie[?] vorhin[?]
Nun ist
$\frac{1+2x+2x^4+}{1+2x^5+2x^{20}+} = \frac{(ix^{\frac12},ix^{\frac32})(ix^{\frac12},-ix^{\frac12})}{(ix^{\frac12},-ix^{\frac32})(ix^{\frac12},ix^{\frac12})} = \frac{(-x^5,xx)(-x^{\frac52},-x)+x(-x^5,-x^3)(-x^5,x^4)}{(-x^5,xx)(-x^{\frac52},-x)-x(-x^5,-x^3)(-x^5,x^4)}$
Woraus der erste zu beweisende Satz von selbst folgt
Ebenso ist
$\frac{1+2x+2x^4+}{1+2x^{25}+2x^{100}+} = \frac{1-\varepsilon x.1-\varepsilon\varepsilon x.1-\varepsilon^3x.1-\varepsilon^4x.1+\varepsilon xx.1+\varepsilon\varepsilon xx.1+\varepsilon^3xx.1+\varepsilon^4xx..}{1+\varepsilon x.1+\varepsilon\varepsilon x.1+\varepsilon^3x.1+\varepsilon^4x\ 1-\varepsilon xx.1-\varepsilon\varepsilon xx.1-\varepsilon^3xx\ 1-\varepsilon^4xx..}$
$= \frac{1-\varepsilon^4.1-\varepsilon\varepsilon}{1+\varepsilon^4.1+\varepsilon\varepsilon}.\frac{(ix^{\frac12},i\varepsilon x^{\frac12}).(ix^{\frac12},i\varepsilon\varepsilon x^{\frac12})}{(ix^{\frac12},-i\varepsilon x^{\frac12}).(ix^{\frac12},i\varepsilon\varepsilon x^{\frac12})} = [-(x,\varepsilon^3 x)-]-\varepsilon x(-x,\varepsilon^3\varepsilon x)($
$= \frac{(\varepsilon^3-[-\varepsilon^4-])(\varepsilon-\varepsilon^4)}{(\varepsilon^3+\varepsilon^4)(\varepsilon+\varepsilon^4)}.\frac{(-x,-\varepsilon^3x).(-x,\varepsilon)-\varepsilon x(-x,\varepsilon^3xx)(-x,-\varepsilon x)}{(-x,-\varepsilon^3x).(-x,\varepsilon)+\varepsilon x(-x,\varepsilon^3xx)(-x,-\varepsilon x)}$
$= \frac{-\varepsilon+\varepsilon\varepsilon+\varepsilon^3-\varepsilon^4}{+\varepsilon+\varepsilon\varepsilon+\varepsilon^3+\varepsilon^4}\ \frac{(x,\varepsilon^3x).(x,-\varepsilon)+\varepsilon^3(x,-\varepsilon^3)(x,\varepsilon x)}{(x,\varepsilon^3x).(x,-\varepsilon)-\varepsilon^3(x,-\varepsilon^3)(x,\varepsilon x)}$
Woraus der zweite zu beweisende Satz von selbst folgt

$(x,x) = 2(1+xx)^2(1+x^4)^2\ldots = \frac{[x^4]^2}{[xx]^2}$
$(x,1) = (1+x)^2(1+x^3)^2\ldots = \frac{[xx]^4}{[x]^2[x^4]^2}$
Man hat also
$(x,\alpha)^2 = \frac{[x^4]^2}{[xx]^2}\{(xx,\alpha\alpha)\frac{[x^4]^4}{[xx]^2[x^8]^2} + x\alpha(xx,\alpha\alpha xx)\frac{[x^8]^2}{[x^4]^2}\}$
